subject: [PATCH v3 12/12] nfsd: move ctime when CB_GETATTR applies a delegated mtime

2026-11-24.patch_summary: This patch fixes a timestamp update issue in the NFS daemon by always setting the ctime attribute when an applied mtime is set, and only setting the ctime_set flag if the vetted ctime passes validation. This ensures that rejected ctimes are updated to the current time, matching the behavior of SETATTR with delegated times.
